author: core_review
scope: CPU action phase, native supervised executor, explicit GPU refusal and opt-in artifact metadata watch; not the complete V1-06 research loop.

baseline.provenance: Preceding implementation checkpoint, not a released-version incident.

classification.note: All APIs are new mechanisms; missing APIs are not old-version reds. Queue KeyError is a candidate integration error, not observed unauthorized GPU execution. Initial blocked-worker return-code assertion was a fixture premise error, not a product defect. Root and runtime actual CPU interface/publication reds are separately attributed below; overlapping target runs are not added together.

mechanisms.entry: Persistent native_cpu_action kind and phase action; kind-aware proposal dedup, metadata/Kind agreement, explicit CPU claim with gpu=None and resource=cpu.
mechanisms.lifecycle: Global FSM remains shared; CPU has only action stage. Old training/evaluation pipeline retained. Shared supervisor/member/termination whitelists add action.
mechanisms.executor: Actual READY worker PID, complete AttemptRef, sealed input FD, fresh admission and exact durable permit scope/task/timeout before prepare and GO. No GPU leases/compute receipts. Unknown owner/slot retained; no automatic no-execution claim.
mechanisms.publication: Tree closure before preparation; output copies/hash outside writer; expected artifact metadata watch at registration-to-terminal boundary and before/after commit; file identity recheck after finish. Whole effect guard exits before budget settlement.
mechanisms.budget: Budget module is peer-authored. Native binds fixed reservation_id and checks complete captured permit. Slot release only peer self-verification after confirmed terminal/effect; no wall-envelope refund.
mechanisms.diagnostics: DEVNULL stdout/stderr; elapsed_wall_seconds measured from immediately before GO through observed closure, not CPU usage. Empty outputs have zero artifacts and zero observations.

candidate_reds.issue: sealed input FD initially at EOF for ordinary os.read
candidate_reds.author_fix: Checked lseek(fd,0,SEEK_SET) only in CPU adapter, not shared sealed helper.
Canonical exact task/results/mainDB/timeout comparison before intent and again before prepare/GO.

candidate_reds.issue: GPU queue guard indexed nonexistent kind in real get_queue rows
candidate_reds.author_fix: Read persistent kind through existing lake.get without changing get_queue return contract.

candidate_reds.issue: AFTER terminal trigger rewrote artifact record after registration, yet native returned/settled
candidate_reds.author_fix: New opt-in execution_transaction artifact watch; CPU uses prepared expected records, commit pre/post readback plus final file identity check.
candidate_reds.peer_fixture_note: Peer reported an initial wrong-column fixture error, corrected before its business red with original assert AST preserved; see peer report.

complete_snapshot_replays.scope: Only listed complete candidate modules are re-executed in a fresh test process; filesystem production modules are unchanged. This is not a whole baseline checkout replay.
